title: Year-end adjustments reduced the institute’s reported net assets by $3.4 million

beats.text: In FY2019, late reconciliations reduced the institute’s reported net assets by about $200,000.
The next year the accounts included unearned tuition, expenses, and receivables.

visual.kicker: The following year produced a much larger correction

beats.text: Auditors lowered the reported net assets by about $3.4 million.

visual.kicker: The following year produced a much larger correction

beats.text: That was 54.8% of the unaudited annual change in net assets.
FY2021 brought another adjustment of about $237,000.
The institute reported a new accounting system and qualified personnel.

visual.kicker: The FY2021 adjustment was smaller but the finding persisted

beats.text: The FY2022 summary marked the finding corrected.

visual.kicker: The following auditors tested the corrective action

beats.text: The auditors verified that systems were in place to reconcile the institute’s records.

visual.kicker: The following auditors tested the corrective action

beats.text: The records document corrections to the books. They do not report a cash recovery.
